title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

£40,000 - £55,000

London (3 days a week)

This is an exciting opportunity for a Data Engineer to join a highly data-driven business where technology plays a central role in shaping commercial decisions. You'll take ownership of critical database and data engineering projects, working on large-scale SQL Server architecture, data transformation initiatives, and emerging AI-focused projects. The role offers significant responsibility, strong stakeholder exposure, and the chance to influence the future direction of a growing data function.

THE COMPANY

They are an established digital-first organisation that has built its success through the intelligent use of data, analytics, and technology. Operating at scale with a large consumer audience, they invest heavily in understanding user behaviour and turning insights into business outcomes.

The data team works closely with stakeholders across multiple business functions, creating a collaborative environment where technical expertise and communication skills are equally valued. With growing investment in AI and data capabilities, this is an excellent opportunity to join at a pivotal stage of development.

THE ROLE

As a Data Engineer, you will take ownership of a major SQL Server transformation programme, designing and building scalable data solutions from scratch while working closely with stakeholders across the business.

Specifically, you can expect to be involved in the following:

  • Design and build SQL Server databases from scratch, including schema design, stored procedures, tables, views, and indexing.
  • Redesign and optimise an existing SQL Server estate to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Develop and maintain ETL workflows and data ingestion pipelines.
  • Build automation solutions using Python and API integrations.
  • Support data migration and database transformation initiatives.
  • Maintain and enhance reporting and dashboarding capabilities.
  • Partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data solutions.
  • Contribute to AI and machine learning projects through robust data architecture and engineering.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

The successful Data Engineer will have the following skills and experience:

  • Strong commercial experience with SQL Server, including database architecture and schema design.
  • Experience building database environments from scratch rather than solely supporting existing systems.
  • Experience with SSIS and ETL development.
  • Exposure to Azure data technologies and cloud-based data solutions.
  • Python development experience for automation and data engineering use cases.
  • Experience working with APIs and data integrations.
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or other data visualisation tools.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Interest in AI, machine learning, and modern data technologies.

BENEFITS

The successful Data Engineer will receive the following benefits:

  • Salary between £40,000 - £55,000 - depending on experience

HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest by sending your resume to Majid Latif via the Apply link on this page.
